power_types.name: Land Vehicles
power_types.description: The ability to have mastered transport whilst driving on roads, rough terrain, and in vehicles such as cars, bikes, trucks, and tanks.

power_types.name: Air Vehicles
power_types.description: The ability to pilot aircraft and push them to their limits, including planes and helicopters.

power_types.name: Seaborne Vehicles
power_types.description: The ability to drive boats, submarines, and ships with little difficulty.

power_types.name: Space Vehicles
power_types.description: The ability to fly and maneuver ships or shuttles through dangerous hazards and difficult situations.
